Name: Simple Tool Charging
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Tool Charging

Spend less time holding the button! Simple Tool Charging makes upgraded [b]Watering Cans and Hoes[/b] charge progressively faster while keeping vanilla charge visuals synchronized.

[b]Charge speeds[/b]
[list]
[*]Basic: unchanged[/*]
[*]Copper: [b]1.25×[/b][/*]
[*]Steel: [b]1.50×[/b][/*]
[*]Gold: [b]1.75×[/b][/*]
[*]Iridium: [b]2.00×[/b][/*]
[/list]Your tools keep their normal affected areas, stamina and water costs, charge levels and release behavior. Regular swings and other tools are unaffected.

[b]Configuration[/b]
Adjust each tier’s speed in
[code]config.json[/code], or disable the effect separately for Hoes and Watering Cans.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]. Extract the
[code]SimpleToolCharging[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
No textures or save data are changed. Mods that replace charging or player animation logic may conflict. Multiplayer and animation-mod combinations have not yet been playtested.
